english: You kneel down to look at the cat-like skull on the ground.
E-"Okay. I'll leave you to it." (Pat the top of the skull.)
My head's as empty as that skull, Cleric.
Can you talk to this skull for me? If I cast a spell for it?
Okay. Well... if you think it's helpful.
You will need someone who speaks the tongue of this creature.
You finish casting the spell, and the skull begins to make a clacking sound.
The jaw opening and closing, with a jitter.
Okay. So, you tell me what you want me to ask.
You hear him whisper to himself, "You can do this."
Ask what it's like being dead.
Ask what it is voting in the election.
Ask him about the meaning of life.
The skull almost shrieks, "Mi devoción a mi dios y a mi deber es mi único interés; los gustos terrenales son pasajeros."
He likes his job. It's a great devotion. To his god. Earthly enjoyments are... fleeting.
Mi nombre es el Vengador Rojo. Pero antes de ser eso, yo era Liethion Baluba.
His name is 'the avenging red'. And also... 'Lietsi Balba'?
Very strange. This is a weird guy.
The skull speaks, "Mi tiempo fue entregado por el ojo rojo."
He says, his... his time is given to the 'red eye'. Whatever that means.
Uh. Cuál... es tu comida... favorita?
Mi sustento es el honor de servir y proteger.
He's voting for service. And protection.
Well then. He'll clearly be voting for me, as future god-king-wizard, in that case.
Another vote, not cast for the Agrarians... (Feel sick.)
A vague answer. He's clearly an apolitical cat.
He quickly looks to the side. Nervously.
Ellos están en todas partes. Nuestros hijos. Nuestros seguidores. Debemos luchar para vengarlos, en nombre del ojo rojo.
Oh gods, that's a lot... he...
He says his people need to be avenged. For the red eye. How cryptic.
He grimaces as he attempts to speak.
Cada cosa tiene un significado profundo, revelado solo a través de la devoción y el sacrificio.
Meaning is sacrifice. Devotion. Feels like this guy's a zealot.
One question left. Make it count.
The corpse's mouth stiffens once more, and the mimicking of life ends.
